summary: Presents operational, policy and security recommendations for operators of DNS recursive resolvers that offer privacy services. It helps operators decide deliberately which services to provide and understand the effects of their choices. It is a best current practice.

eli5.summary: If you run a service that answers other people's website name lookups, you could see what they look up. This document advises how to run it in a way that respects their privacy.

questions: how to run a private dns resolver
what are best practices for dns privacy operators
